key.name: window-width
key.description: The width of the main window in pixels.

key.name: window-height
key.description: The height of the main window in pixels.

key.name: window-maximized
key.description: Whether the main window is maximized.

key.name: last-project
key.description: The path of the most recently opened project file.

key.name: reopen-last-project
key.description: Whether to reopen the most recently used project on startup when no project is given.

key.name: show-bubble
key.summary: Show the webcam bubble on screen while recording
key.description: Whether to show a floating round webcam bubble on the screen while recording, which marks where the webcam appears in the video.

key.name: countdown
key.summary: Seconds of countdown before recording starts
key.description: The number of seconds to count down before recording starts. Set to 0 to start recording immediately.

key.name: process-audio
key.description: After recording, automatically reduce noise, even out levels and normalize loudness for online video. Projects can also turn it off with audio.processing.

key.name: mirror-camera
key.description: Flip the webcam horizontally, like a mirror, in the video and in the on-screen bubble. A project can override it with camera.mirror.

key.name: camera-device
key.description: Device path of the webcam to use (for example /dev/video0). Empty to use the one set in the project.

key.name: microphone-device
key.description: Audio input to use: a PulseAudio/PipeWire source name, "default", or "none". Empty to use the one set in the project.
